title: nf-core/methylarray pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

Sample_Name.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample_id.description: Optional identifier used to join with the --meta_file metadata CSV (must match the sample_id column). If omitted, Sample_Name is used as the join key.

Sentrix_ID.errorMessage: Sentrix array ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

Sentrix_Position.errorMessage: Sentrix position must be provided in format R##C## (e.g. R01C01)
